briefs.designMd:
# Design direction

Acme Shop: a small online shop's back office. Calm, plain and accountable. One accent colour (primary) for actions and focus only; everything else stays neutral. Numbers use tabular figures.

## Palette

See design/tokens.json: primary, text, textMuted, surface, surfaceMuted, border, success, warning, danger.
